definitions.explanation: The tendency to believe that others are out to get you or that you are being unfairly targeted. Can refer to the clinical condition or be used colloquially to describe someone who reads hostility into neutral situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{被害妄想|ひがいもうそう}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{被害妄想|ひがいもうそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}くて→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: He has strong paranoia and always thinks someone is talking badly about him.

examples.japanese: {被害妄想|ひがいもうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかなくなること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When you fall into paranoid thinking, your relationships with people around you can suffer.

notes:
USAGE:
In casual speech, {被害妄想|ひがいもうそう} is often used lightly to tell someone they are overthinking or imagining hostility where none exists. In clinical contexts, it refers to a genuine psychiatric symptom.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被害妄想|ひがいもうそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (to be highly paranoid)
- {被害妄想|ひがいもうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ (to fall into paranoid thinking)
- {被害妄想|ひがいもうそう}⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (somewhat paranoid)
